name: AquariumGTK

challenges: Keeping movement, group state, and drawing in sync across animation ticks

name: GTKFinalVers
description: A modular GTK3 widget/parser project with separate parsing, widget-factory, and utility modules.

details.problem: Represent GTK widget properties as structured values, parse interface descriptions, and create the corresponding GTK widgets.
features: Defines records for windows, buttons, labels, menus, entries, and containers
Parses widget attributes into typed structures
Creates GTK widgets from parsed records
Includes separate parser, utility, and widget-factory modules
challenges: Keeping parser attributes aligned with the many widget-specific properties
Composing nested GTK containers from parsed input
learned: Decomposing a GTK application into parsing, data-model, and widget-construction modules

suggestedDescription: A modular C/GTK3 project for parsing interface descriptions and constructing native widgets.
